# MenuItem

```ts
import { MenuItem } from '@cake-admin/cakeand';
```

Menu Item is a compact action row for application menus. Its variant="sub-item" variation provides the Figma sub-item indentation for hierarchical menu content. Use Button for actions outside a menu and Checkbox for independent form selection.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `children` | `React.ReactNode` | **required** | Visible row label. |
| `variant` | `'item' \| 'sub-item'` | `'item'` | Figma Menu Items row or its indented Menu Subitems variation. |
| `selected` | `boolean` | `false` | Applies the Figma primary-tonal selected treatment. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables the action and dims all row content. |
| `showLeftSlot` | `boolean` | `true` | Shows the 16px leading slot. |
| `leftSlot` | `React.ReactNode` | — | Decorative leading content; defaults to the Figma refresh glyph. |
| `showRightSlot` | `boolean` | `true` | Shows the 16px trailing slot. |
| `rightSlot` | `React.ReactNode` | — | Decorative trailing content; defaults to the Figma check glyph. |
| `showCheckbox` | `boolean` | `false` | Shows the reusable 24px Checkbox before the row action. This is only available on the top-level item variation, matching Figma. |
| `checked` | `boolean` | — | Controlled state for the optional Checkbox. |
| `defaultChecked` | `boolean` | `false` | Uncontrolled initial state for the optional Checkbox. |
| `onCheckedChange` | `(checked: boolean) => void` | — | Fires with the next optional Checkbox value. |

Also accepts all `Omit<React.ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>, 'children' | 'type'>` props.

## Usage

```tsx
<MenuItem>Refresh</MenuItem>
<MenuItem selected>Current workspace</MenuItem>
<MenuItem variant="sub-item">Nested folder</MenuItem>
<MenuItem showCheckbox defaultChecked>Select filters</MenuItem>
<MenuItem leftSlot={<Folder />} rightSlot={<ChevronRight />}>Projects</MenuItem>
<MenuItem disabled>Unavailable action</MenuItem>
```

## Accessibility

- The action is a native button with role="menuitem", so Enter and Space trigger it naturally. Put related rows in a parent with role="menu" when building a full menu.
- Decorative slots are hidden from assistive technology; the visible text is the action’s accessible name.
- Focus is visibly restyled with a primary token ring; disabled items use the native disabled attribute and cannot be activated.
- When showCheckbox is enabled, Checkbox remains an independent labelled control beside the menu action; it is not nested inside the row button.

## Do / Don't

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Use selected for the current menu choice. | Use selected styling as a substitute for keyboard focus. |
| Use sub-item only for a genuine child relationship. | Indent a top-level item only to align arbitrary content. |
| Provide a meaningful text label alongside icons. | Create an icon-only menu row. |
| Use Checkbox for multi-select controls. | Make a row button and checkbox one nested interactive control. |
